short: The protobuf API contract, authoritative over both tiers
is: The API contract — protobuf as the independent IDL, authoritative over BOTH tiers (axum via prost+pbjson, SvelteKit via protobuf-es), owned by neither and generated into both.
conventions: JSON over HTTP is the v1 transport — nothing here implies gRPC; transports are adapters.
`service`/`rpc` blocks exist only to host `google.api.http` annotations; ONLY MESSAGES are generated, handlers stay hand-written but return the generated types.
Path-major is welded to the package: `zurfur.api.v1` ⇒ `/api/v1/…`.
Additive-only within a major; `buf breaking` at WIRE_JSON, the skip label is banned (R9).
R8 vocabularies are documented extensible `string`s, never enums.
Serializer options are contract text pinned by `golden_wire.rs`.
